narrative.overview: Precise, credible, and crafted. Original product artifacts carry the visual character, supported by substantial sans typography and restrained olive surfaces. Content stays visible before animation or JavaScript runs. Product reconstructions retain their independent UI language and are explicitly labelled.
dos: Do lead with supplied artifacts and preserve their visual evidence.
Do use dated, qualified project outcomes and specific decision summaries.
Do maintain both themes, clear focus, and immediately visible text.
donts: Don't invent metrics, testimonials, projects, roles, or illustrative product evidence.
Don't replace original project imagery with decorative stock or generated screenshots.
